checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~2867 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.15 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.

checklist.detail: Near the end of active cooling (area ratio ~77.5), estimated jacket/coolant pressure (~25.1 MPa) exceeds local hot-gas static pressure (~0.0 MPa) - the net load on the channel-land wall there REVERSES direction. Modeled as a clamped-strip bending stress across the ~20.6 mm channel width, this reversed ~25.0 MPa differential is ~21355 MPa against a ~67 MPa allowable (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5) - but this is a coarse clamped-plate-strip proxy, NOT a real buckling/FEA analysis, and this codebase has no real-engine spot check for it yet. Treat this as 'worth a closer structural look', not a validated failure prediction. Consider more/narrower channels (smaller span), tapering the actively-cooled length, or a thicker wall there.
